prompt: Create a stylized anime screenshot displayed inside a modern black smartphone screen, as if viewing a social media story or selfie. The phone fills the frame at a slight diagonal angle, with rounded black bezels, a top notch, small status icons, and the time shown as 11:27. Inside the phone screen is a close-up overhead selfie of a smiling young woman with deep warm brown skin, long straight black hair, large glossy brown anime eyes, defined brows, and a bright friendly grin. She is holding the camera above herself with one arm extended, creating a dynamic wide-angle selfie perspective. She wears a fitted black cropped T-shirt with a white leaf spiral emblem on the chest and dark pants. The setting behind her is a softly blurred anime village street with tan stone pavement, wooden storefronts, greenery at the side, and an orange vertical sign bearing the Japanese character 「忍」. Add a translucent black caption bar across the lower third of the phone screen with centered white text reading Good vibes only 🌿✨✨. Use polished high-quality anime rendering, clean linework, warm cinematic shading, expressive face details, subtle screen glare, shallow depth of field, and a vertical smartphone composition. Keep the image focused on exactly one person, one phone, one caption bar, one visible chest emblem, and one orange background sign.

promptZh: 创作一张显示在现代黑色智能手机屏幕内的风格化动漫截图，呈现出观看社交媒体故事或自拍的效果。手机以轻微的对角线角度填满画面，具有圆润的黑色边框、顶部刘海、小型状态图标，时间显示为 11:27。手机屏幕内是一位年轻女性的俯视特写自拍，她面带微笑，拥有 深暖棕色皮肤、长直黑发、大而有光泽的棕色动漫眼睛、清晰的眉毛以及灿烂友好的笑容。她单手将相机举在头顶上方，营造出动态的广角自拍视角。她身穿一件修身的黑色短款 T 恤，胸前印有白色叶片螺旋标志，下身穿着深色长裤。背景是模糊的动漫村庄街道，铺着棕褐色石板路，有木质店面、侧面的绿植，以及一个带有日文汉字「忍」的橙色竖向招牌。在手机屏幕下三分之一处添加一个半透明的黑色标题栏，并居中显示白色文字 Good vibes only 🌿✨✨。采用精致的高质量动漫渲染、干净的线条、温暖的电影级阴影、富有表现力的面部细节、微妙的屏幕反光、浅景深以及竖屏构图。保持画面聚焦于一个人、一部手机、一个标题栏、一个可见的胸前标志以及一个橙色背景招牌。
